free_tier.stated: Free Tier for Serverless: up to 1,000,000 tokens for models billed by tokens and 60 minutes of audio transcription for models billed by audio minutes; billed per million tokens from token 1,000,001
free_tier.notes: the FAQ and the pricing page state the allowance as a total; whether it renews monthly or is granted once is not stated on either page

tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client at https://api.scaleway.ai/v1; Batches API available
chaining: Scaleway-hosted open models; the Batches API has no rate limit and a 50 per cent discount, which matters once the free tokens are gone

limits.value: 1,000,000 free tokens and 60 minutes of audio transcription in the Free Tier, applied to the most expensive tokens first

unverified: tokens per minute, queries per minute and concurrent requests are limited per organization and the values sit on the Organization quotas page, which was not captured; Batches API requests carry no rate limit

identity_cost.detail: base rate limits apply if a valid payment method is registered and rise automatically after identity verification, quoted from the rate-limits page; whether the free tier can be used before a payment method is registered is not stated

reliability_note: per-model limits are published only as organization quotas behind a separate page, so the ceiling per model is not known
confidence_note: the allowance is quoted from the FAQ and pricing pages and the payment-method statement from the rate-limits page; the organization quota values and the renewal behaviour were not captured.

evidence.proved: Scaleway offers a Free Tier for serverless Generative APIs
evidence.quote: There is a Free Tier available for _Serverless_.
- 1,000,000 tokens for models billed by tokens

evidence.proved: the Free Tier covers 60 minutes of audio transcription
evidence.quote: - 60 minutes of audio transcription for models billed by audio minutes

evidence.proved: pricing page repeats the 1,000,000-token free tier and states where billing starts
evidence.quote: You benefit from a free tier on the first 1,000,000 tokens. You'll be charged from token number 1,000,001.

evidence.proved: rate limits are tied to a registered payment method
evidence.quote: Base limits apply if you registered a valid payment method

evidence.proved: the Batches API is exempt from the rate limit
evidence.quote: Requests performed through the Batches API do not have a rate limit

binding_note: a fixed 1,000,000-token total that is gone after a short run
notes: the verdict is trial-only because the allowance is stated as a total with no renewal; a monthly renewal would move it to a recurring allowance.
